description: Edit an image using AI with a natural language prompt. Models: standard (general-purpose), enhance (realism), upscale (resolution), shadow (light migration, needs reference), kiss (needs reference), skin (retouching), angles (multi-angle), scene (scene change). Input can be a file path or base64 data URL.

image.description: Image to edit: absolute file path, data URL (data:image/png;base64,...), or raw base64

outputPath.description: Save result to this file path instead of returning base64

prompt.description: Editing instruction in plain English, e.g. 'Remove the background'

referenceImage.description: Reference image for shadow/kiss models: file path, data URL, or raw base64

name: xmorf_edit_image
